about: Solo questions, PG-13. Heat 1 opens a turn, heat 3 ends it. 'room' questions are only dealt when other contestants are playing, and never name, rank or judge anyone. SPEC.md §11.

questions.q: Have you ever replied to a message months late and acted normal?
Have you ever pretended not to see someone you knew in a shop?
Have you ever pretended to be on a call to avoid someone?
Have you ever unfollowed someone, then followed them again?
Have you ever claimed a joke you heard as your own?
Do you have a secret playlist you'd never share? Why not?
Have you ever lied about your age? Up or down?
When did you last leave a message on read on purpose?
Do you check who viewed your story more than once?
Have you ever opened a present early and wrapped it back up?
What's the longest you've hidden in a bathroom at a party?
Have you ever re-read your own post just to admire it?
When did you last exaggerate a story to make it funnier?
Have you ever put an empty box back in the cupboard?
Have you ever left a party without saying goodbye?
Have you ever sent a message to the wrong group chat? What did it say?
Have you ever looked through a friend's bathroom cabinet?
When did you last look up an old classmate online?
Have you ever eaten someone else's food from a shared fridge?
Have you ever faked being sick to skip a party?
Have you ever taken credit for a group project you barely helped with?
Have you ever screenshotted a chat to show someone else?
Have you ever turned up late and blamed the traffic?
Have you ever watched ahead on a show you promised to watch with someone?
Be honest: have you ever acted surprised by news you already knew?
Have you ever said 'we should hang out' with no plan to?
Have you ever pretended to be into a hobby to impress someone?
Be honest: have you ever read someone's texts without asking?
Have you ever liked an old photo by accident while snooping?
Have you ever told someone their cooking was great when it wasn't?
Have you ever let someone else take the blame for something you did?
Have you ever made up a story to get out of trouble? What was it?
Is there a secret you promised to keep but didn't?
Have you ever gossiped about someone, then been extra nice to them?
Have you ever pretended to be happy for someone when you were jealous?
Have you ever ignored a text from someone in this room?
